content.value_statement: Mobile teams must protect sensitive data across storage, WebViews, networking, and authentication. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code apply platform-aware secure coding patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guides secure WebView configuration with HTTPS enforcement and restricted file access.
Recommends secure local storage patterns for Keychain, Keystore, encrypted databases, and protected caches.
Supports mobile authentication planning with biometrics, MFA, OAuth PKCE, and secure session handling.
Covers network security controls such as certificate validation, pinning, and downgrade protection.
Provides platform guidance for Android, iOS, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, Cordova, and PWA security.
Helps review mobile code for input validation, data leakage, privacy, and hardening gaps.
limitations: It provides guidance and review support, not a full penetration test.
It depends on the user providing platform, framework, and threat model details.
It cannot verify runtime behavior without access to build artifacts or test results.
It may need project-specific legal review for privacy and compliance obligations.

use_cases.title: Harden a Mobile Feature
use_cases.description: Plan secure storage, network, and input validation controls before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review WebView Risk
use_cases.description: Evaluate WebView settings, JavaScript exposure, file access, cookies, and content security controls.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Security Checks
use_cases.description: Create a mobile release checklist for authentication, privacy, logging, backups, and platform hardening.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this mobile feature for security risks. Focus on sensitive data, permissions, input validation, and safe defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Secure Storage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design secure local storage for my app. Include platform storage choices, encryption, backup handling, and biometric access controls.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a WebView
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this WebView design. Recommend controls for URL allowlists, JavaScript, file access, cookies, CSP, and session cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Threat Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a mobile threat model for this app. Cover authentication, APIs, offline data, device compromise, privacy, and release validation.

output_examples.input: Review our payment WebView plan for a React Native app.
output_examples.output: A review covering trusted domain rules, JavaScript bridge exposure, cookie isolation, HTTPS enforcement, CSP, and cleanup after payment completion.

output_examples.input: Plan secure storage for tokens and offline profile data.
output_examples.output: A storage plan using platform key stores for secrets, encrypted local databases for profile data, backup exclusions, and clear retention rules.

output_examples.input: Create a pre-release mobile security checklist.
output_examples.output: A checklist for authentication, certificate validation, logging, sensitive screen protection, dependency checks, privacy consent, and release hardening.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, framework, data types, and threat model before asking for guidance.
Ask for implementation checks and verification steps, not only design recommendations.
Validate recommendations against OWASP MASVS, platform documentation, and your release requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not request generic security advice without platform or feature details.
Do not store secrets in source code, logs, shared preferences, or unprotected local files.
Do not enable WebView JavaScript, file access, or broad URL loading without a clear control plan.

faq.question: Does this skill write mobile security code?
faq.answer: It can guide secure implementation patterns and review code, but final integration depends on your project.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, Cordova, Unity mobile, and mobile PWAs.

faq.question: Can it replace a penetration test?
faq.answer: No. It supports secure coding and review, but it does not replace hands-on mobile testing.

faq.question: Does it support compliance work?
faq.answer: It can help identify privacy and data protection controls, but legal compliance needs qualified review.

faq.question: Can it help with WebView security?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers URL allowlists, JavaScript controls, file access restrictions, cookies, CSP, and cleanup.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
